Actually, let me reconsider. The pink object is a cross shape (5 pixels). Let me look at its exact shape.
Row 19: col 21 = P (the top of the cross)
Row 20: cols 20-22 = PPP (the middle of the cross)
Row 21: col 21 = P (the bottom of the cross)
So the pink object is a plus/cross shape.
Now, let me test clicking it. Let me click at row 20, col 21 (the center).
Let me do that.
Actually, let me reconsider the whole game. The pink object is a "target" that I need to click. And the green objects are "bricks" that I need to destroy.
But I already destroyed all the green bricks in the previous wave, and it didn't complete.
Wait, maybe the goal is to click the pink object (the target) AND destroy the green bricks.
Let me test clicking the pink object first.
Let me click at row 20, col 21.
